title: Madhya Pradesh overtakes Indian Punjab: satellite fire spots in October, 2019–2026
note: Fire counts are satellite fire spots (heat detections), not confirmed fires.

evidence.claim: IN, 10-01 to 10-24: 2026 has 12,600 Suomi NPP fire spots, rank 4 of 8 years with the same coverage since 2019; the mean of earlier years with the same coverage is 12,564.4 (+0.3%).

From 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-24 (24 archived days, Pakistan time), HamariHawa counted 42,420 distinct satellite fire spots: 9,702 in Pakistan and 32,718 in India, 21,955 of them labelled crop fires. The busiest day was 2026-10-23 with 3,231.
